text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The pack swings out of the fourth corner into the home stretch!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (—Right here! From this very moment...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My legs... feel so heavy...! Even though I have to make my move from here...!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Urrrghhh, aaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
...The much-watched Satono Diamond
fails to claim the crown in the Satsuki Sho!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*... *pant, gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ah... Couldn't reach in time, huh. Satono Diamond didn't have quite the late stretch we expected.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to struggle at the end.
Judging by that, would long distances be tough for her...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something felt off about her running during the race.
Towards the end, Satono Diamond was clearly exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Could it be that... she ran all the way to the racetrack before the race, exhausting her stamina...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I hadn't run, I wouldn't have made it to the race in time.
It couldn't be helped, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(...It took everything I had just to finish the 2000m...
Running like that, 1st place is out of the question...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Even so, if only I were stronger...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...
choice_data_list: Sorry for making you run all the way to the racetrack.
Sorry for making you run all the way to the racetrack, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer, it's not something
you need to apologize for!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I agree that getting out of the taxi
and running was the best choice back then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... why did the weather have to be terrible today of all days?
To lose without even being able to show 100% of my strength..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Umamusume can't win a G1."
I was trapped by that jinx too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will break the jinx myself!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: At the next Japan Derby! This time, I will overcome the jinx and claim victory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond declares with conviction.
Facing bad luck seemed to have fired her up even more,
determined not to let any jinx beat her.
